notes: GeoTalk 3.4.0: SPEED UPDATE — calls and messages now feel real-time. Incoming calls ring almost instantly, the call connection is prepared while the phone is still ringing (no setup wait after Accept), messages in an open chat arrive within about a second, and Random Chat matches faster. Everything from 3.3 is kept: direct phone-to-phone WebRTC voice first, Cloudflare TURN relay (UDP, TCP and TLS 443) when a network blocks the direct path, Push-to-Talk as the final fallback, plus internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, voice messages and in-app updates.
